title: Empowering
slide_intent: Teach writers to preserve a person’s ownership of their story. The reader should hear that individual’s experience in their own voice.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can foreground the people it supports and show the human impact of its work without taking over their account.
demonstration: The fourth principle centers personal experience and asks the writer to preserve authenticity when clarifying a story. The writing column assigns the organization a supporting role.
practical_value: Check whose viewpoint leads a profile. Preserve the individual’s language when editing and retain the complexity of their experience.

content_islands.name: Principle identifier
content_islands.spec: Mark Empowering in the chapter rail. Pair the large pale numeral 4 with its pink nameplate and the cyan underline.

content_islands.name: Definition and limits
content_islands.spec: Introduce the principle as personal and respectful, then set the guidance on people telling their own stories beside its boundaries.

content_islands.name: Writing guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the right column for the individual’s role, careful editing and empathy. Keep the organization’s role secondary.
